verdict.rationale: Snyk offers AI-adjacent triage support — DeepCode AI-driven risk scoring/prioritization (issue prevalence, ease of fix, risk factor) and step-by-step vulnerability flow explanations — plus a Remediation Agent that scans and generates fix plans with security intelligence context. However, there is no explicit evidence of AI-driven deduplication of findings or automated false-positive flagging; ignoring findings is a manual suppression action, not an AI-suggested false-positive determination. Missing for 10: explicit AI-based deduplication of duplicate/related findings, explicit AI classification/flagging of likely false positives (vs. manual suppression), and independent evidence these triage aids work well in practice.
